note: Non-technical, plain-language tips for parents — no jargon, no JSON. Shown in Parent Dashboard.

today_tips.title: Talk
today_tips.prompt: “What animal sound made you laugh today?” Let them roar, then guess.
today_tips.why: Builds listening and vocabulary — no screen needed.

today_tips.title: Do
today_tips.prompt: Build a tower with 5 blocks, add 2 — “How many now?” Count together.
today_tips.why: Practises adding within 10 with real things.

today_tips.title: Wind-down
today_tips.prompt: Look at something far away (a tree, a door). Breathe in, breathe out together.
today_tips.why: Gentle eye rest — replaces the 20-20-20 story in class.

weekly_ideas.idea: Sort socks by color — “Which two match?”
Name 3 feelings today: happy, calm, excited?
Read one story aloud, ask: “What would you do?”
Weather check: “Sunny — what do we wear?”
Print one worksheet — trace, count, or color together

eye_care_plain: Warm filter stays ON — soft yellow, not harsh white.
Every 20 minutes Leo says ‘look far’ — it’s a story, not a lock.
Daily time ends gently — offers printable play, not a countdown.
Best after screen: warm paper, crayons, daylight, and hugs.
